workspace-natural.webp.note: Illustrative natural workplace, not the provider's actual office. The empty generated screen receives the real OMF screenshot as a separate HTML layer. The available built-in tool does not expose model-version selection; version 2.5 is not asserted.

portrait-placeholder.webp.note: Anonymous charcoal portrait study; not a photograph or representation of the provider. Visible caption and image alt text identify it as a replaceable placeholder.

signature-mark.svg.note: Original loose handwritten-looking abstract mark inspired by the emfau brand. No real person's signature or full name was copied. Replaceable standalone SVG; not an ImageGen asset.

reused_sources.note: All OMF and Signature website images, project URLs, fonts and logo are reused unchanged. No invented screenshots or new customer claims.
